result.topic_en: Riemann determines the distribution of tension-electricity (electrostatic potential) in a ring-shaped (toroidal) metallic conductor of constant resistance, cut at one cross-section where a constant electromotive force acts, using toroidal-type coordinates, and then derives the surface charge density.
